findings.explanation: The setting recognition disappears, leaving a vague fragment.
A truncated English word visibly breaks the action line.

findings.evidenceJa: 貫通しかけたぐらい剣で刺された
findings.governingReading: a sword stabbed it nearly all the way through
findings.explanation: A nearly penetrating wound is reported as a completed through-and-through stab.

findings.highlight: gets to my brain and makes me dizzy
findings.evidenceJa: 脳に回って粗雑になる
findings.governingReading: reaches my brain and makes my thinking coarse
findings.explanation: The line’s damaged quality of thought is replaced by a generic balance sensation.

findings.evidenceJa: 思考だけがまとまらない
findings.governingReading: only my thoughts will not come together
findings.explanation: Disorganized thought is exaggerated into an inability to think at all.

findings.highlight: there’s something she needs to know
findings.evidenceJa: 言わなくちゃいけないコトもできちまった
findings.governingReading: there is now something I have to say
findings.explanation: Shirou’s obligation to speak is reassigned as Rin’s need to know.

findings.highlight: When my senses return, I’m in front of the station
findings.evidenceJa: 気が付けば、駅前に足を運んでいた
findings.governingReading: before I know it, my feet have carried me to the station
findings.explanation: An idiom for belated awareness becomes recovery of his senses and omits his bodily movement.

findings.highlight: I can only follow my instincts
findings.explanation: The unknown image or impulse directing Shirou is confidently identified as instinct.

findings.highlight: People normally die when they are killed
findings.evidenceJa: 人間は傷つけば死ぬの
findings.governingReading: people die when they are wounded
findings.explanation: Rin’s warning about the lethality of wounds is replaced by a tautology about already being killed.

findings.highlight: …Coldly tell me so as if it’s the last warning.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後通牒のように、冷淡に告げていた
findings.governingReading: her gaze coldly told me so, like an ultimatum
findings.explanation: The cross-page English continuation is an ungrammatical fragment and obscures the eyes as the conveying subject.
